create_range_hook: create a RangeHook object with a name and optional min or max bounds for field validation
test_range_hook_creation: test that creating a RangeHook with both min and max as None raises MissingRangeHookError
test_out_of_range_init: test that initializing DummyInstance with out-of-range values raises OutOfRangeHookError for number, counter, or pressure fields
test_in_range_init_and_update: test that DummyInstance accepts in-range values and allows field updates within valid ranges
test_init_and_update_range: test that updating DummyInstance fields to out-of-range values raises OutOfRangeHookError after valid initialization
